name: Sophie Dubois
bio:
Sophie Dubois's career in motorsport PR began somewhat unexpectedly. Originally a journalist covering local auto races in the south of France, she quickly developed a keen understanding of the sport's nuances and the personalities driving it. Her ability to craft compelling narratives and build strong relationships with drivers and team personnel led to her transition into a full-time PR role.

Sophie is known for her meticulous approach and unwavering dedication. She believes in proactively shaping the team's image, anticipating potential issues, and ensuring every communication reflects the highest standards. This demanding approach has earned her both respect and a reputation for pushing those around her to excel. She is particularly skilled at crisis management and media training, drawing on her journalistic background to anticipate and mitigate potential negative publicity.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, sleek bob with subtle layers
physical.description: A slender woman with a sharp, intelligent gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and reminders.
Has a peculiar habit of adjusting her glasses whenever stressed.
